definitions.explanation: Physical shrinking or wasting away, especially of muscles or organs due to lack of use or disease.

definitions.gloss: being intimidated; shrinking back; feeling overwhelmed
definitions.explanation: Psychological state of feeling intimidated or overwhelmed, causing one to hold back or become timid.

examples.japanese: {筋肉|きんにく}が{萎縮|いしゅく}しないようにリハビリをする。
examples.english: Do rehabilitation to prevent muscle atrophy.

examples.japanese: {上司|じょうし}の{前|まえ}では{萎縮|いしゅく}してしまう。
examples.english: I feel intimidated in front of my boss.

examples.japanese: {市場|しじょう}の{萎縮|いしゅく}が{懸念|けねん}される。
examples.english: There are concerns about market contraction.

notes:
WORD STRUCTURE:
{萎|い} (wither, shrink) + {縮|しゅく} (shrink, contract)
Both characters relate to becoming smaller.

MEDICAL CONTEXT:
・{筋|きん}{萎縮|いしゅく} - muscle atrophy
・{脳|のう}{萎縮|いしゅく} - brain atrophy
・{胃|い}{萎縮|いしゅく} - gastric atrophy

PSYCHOLOGICAL CONTEXT:
・{萎縮|いしゅく}してしまう - to become intimidated
・{萎縮|いしゅく}せずに - without being intimidated
・{萎縮|いしゅく}{効果|こうか} - chilling effect

ECONOMIC CONTEXT:
・{経済|けいざい}の{萎縮|いしゅく} - economic contraction
・{市場|しじょう}の{萎縮|いしゅく} - market shrinkage

NOTE ON READINGS:
{萎縮|いしゅく} is the standard reading. The word may also be seen as {委縮|いしゅく} with a different first kanji.
